research_question: Can an explicit controller allocate trainable local correction units only on observed need, consolidate repeated identity exceptions into provisional semantic rules, and retract incorrect generalizations?

provenance.U: User proposed networks choosing width/length as needed and internal SLE interfaces.
provenance.A: This bounded growth and reversible consolidation experiment.
provenance.T: Only runs and verification archived in this study count as new evidence.
provenance.F: Prior handfilled wordlevel core and primary literature are reused sources.

grid.base: Known handfilled context/meaning rule, logit 2 for its correct operation and 0 for the other three. No old learned checkpoint is retrained.
grid.input: Exact context and word IDs plus known word-to-meaning mapping. This isolates growth policy, not learning language perception.

randomization.note: Seeds randomize namespace and affected operation, not zero-initialized optimization.

worlds.shared: All six aliases of the affected group in context 1 change.
worlds.isolated2: Only alias indices 0 and 1 of that group in context 1 change.
worlds.isolated3: Only alias indices 0,1,2 of that group in context 1 change.

heldout: Affected-group alias indices 4 and 5 in context1 are never taught; private scorer only.

architecture.cell: Four trainable residual logits, zero initialized, plus three fixed nonzero gate coefficients. Exact identity cells override a shared rule when both match; all residuals add to unchanged base logits.
architecture.growth_unit: One new gated hidden unit with four trainable output values.
architecture.demotion: Remove provisional group unit and recreate exact cells for distinct observed keys in this group whose labels differ from base, training each from zero using its stored label. Shared-rule contradiction includes a newly observed original/base label.
architecture.promotion: After recording each visible label, require at least K DISTINCT exact word IDs within the same context/meaning group, every observed label equal, and that label differ from base. Add and train one shared cell from zero; release exact cells in that group. Any mixed labels prevent promotion thereafter.
architecture.controller: External deterministic software policy, not a learned architecture policy.

training.ordinary_update: Train only if the currently observed label is predicted incorrectly. Preallocated has all 48 zero cells at start; always_exact creates a cell for every first-seen key, including already-correct ones; demand_exact creates only when incorrect.
training.shared_update: On an active rule contradiction, demote/rebuild before repairing the current key. At promotion, train one shared cell for 100 steps. No hidden full-grid or heldout labels enter controller state.
training.stop: Exactly 9 events for every seed/world/arm; no early stop, seed selection, tuning, or human intervention.

evaluation.before_feedback: Prediction on current labeled stream item before its label is released.
after_feedback: Accuracy on all unchanged-target pairs relative to base
Accuracy on observed unique pairs against current world
Accuracy on the four affected support aliases
Accuracy on the two permanently held aliases
Maximum changes in frozen base coefficients
Active cells, cumulative creations/removals, optimizer update count, trainable coefficients, gate coefficients, retained policy evidence records
evaluation.stages: Initial and after each of nine events; archive full logits/predictions and state.
evaluation.retention: Pairs whose target really changes are excluded from unchanged-retention denominator.
evaluation.cost: Count base, routing keys, gates, output values, Adam state and policy evidence separately. Consolidating active units does not imply deleting evidence or reducing all information.

verification.independent: Array-only verifier must reconstruct dense ReLU gates and priority routing from archived states without importing model or runner; recompute metrics and policy decisions; finite-difference residual loss and Adam check separately.
verification.integration: Reuse verified core/cache without crediting old tests as new. Run a small separate direct W check on distinct core operations selected by trained growth snapshots; archive raw bits and trace. This does not prove SLE syntax is superior.

claims_boundary: Synthetic noiseless labels and known semantic groups only.
Frozen base is handfilled and already correct.
Rule grouping and growth choices are externally specified.
No fixed finite prefix distinguishes a genuine shared rule from matching isolated exceptions.
This does not test autonomous invention of depth, task discovery, noisy data, natural language, SLE encoding efficiency, or long-term compute savings.
